meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 处理天文数据与物理量计算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用Python做天文数据处理或模拟。
copy.tagline_en: Process astronomical data and physical quantities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with astronomical data or simulations in Python.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 Astropy 库处理天文数据，包括单位转换、坐标变换、FITS 文件读写、表格操作、时间计算、宇宙学计算和 WCS 变换。
howto.when: 当你要求进行天文数据分析、坐标转换、FITS 文件处理、宇宙学计算或时间系统转换时触发。

say.text: 帮我将赤道坐标 (10.5°, 41.2°) 转换为银道坐标。
say.note: Claude 会使用 SkyCoord 进行坐标变换。

say.text: 读取 FITS 文件 'image.fits' 并显示其结构。
say.note: Claude 会使用 fits.open 读取文件。

say.text: 计算红移 z=1.5 的光度距离。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Planck18 宇宙学模型计算。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Astropy library for astronomical data processing, including unit conversion, coordinate transformation, FITS I/O, table operations, time handling, cosmology calculations, and WCS transformations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for astronomical data analysis, coordinate conversion, FITS file processing, cosmology calculations, or time system conversions.

say_en.text: Convert equatorial coordinates (10.5°, 41.2°) to galactic coordinates.
say_en.note: Claude will use SkyCoord for transformation.

say_en.text: Read the FITS file 'image.fits' and show its structure.
say_en.note: Claude will use fits.open to read the file.

say_en.text: Calculate the luminosity distance at redshift z=1.5.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Planck18 cosmology model.
